title: Antam Posts 240% Profit Surge in 1H25, Nickel Drives Record Sales and ESG Commitments Strengthen Position
body: PT Antam’s first‑half 2025 net profit surged 240% to Rp5.14 trillion, largely thanks to a 125% jump in nickel sales (Rp7.87 trillion) and 9.10 Mt ore production, while gold sales climbed 163% to Rp49.54 trillion. The company also advanced its bauxite smelter project with Inalum, launched a digital gold retail app, and rolled out a 2030 decarbonisation roadmap targeting 15.8% emission cuts and 10% renewable energy increase.
